items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: was that Hugo Friedhofer or was it Bernie Herman's picture.

ctx.x: Uh huh. Let me go back to your work in one film in the early 50's, "The Snows of Kilimanjaro". Do you recall what you did there?

Yes. Well, I appeared in the film as, you know, a saxophone soloist. I did some writing; I don't remember the extent of it now, but it was just some, you know, arranging. That was ... let's see, was that Hugo Friedhofer or was it Bernie Herman's picture.
I think that was Bernard Herman.
